title: Los primeros radios de Radio Sutatenza
version: Red de Bibliotecas del Banco de la República, BLAA bulletin 1, August 2020; article byline on p. 14.
lineage: Archival account by the custodian of the ACPO collection. It draws on the same collection as the UNESCO nomination but adds identifiable transmitter and receiver images. The original Spanish PDF was opened; the archive images are retained by their custodian.

passages.quote: ensambló en Sutatenza (Boyacá) el primer transmisor de la emisora
passages.note: Salcedo assembled the first transmitter in Sutatenza in 1947.

passages.locator: p. 15, Los inicios, final paragraphs and images 1–2
passages.note: Names Irzón as an early receiving locality and describes the use of fixed-frequency receivers there. Image 1 identifies the first transmitter in Archivo ACPO 1–8, album 8, photo 4. Image 2 reproduces a receiver photograph from Álvaro Sánchez, Escuelas Radiofónicas, Ministerio de Educación Nacional, 1951, p. 41.
